basic_details.job_title: GMCHT Social Worker Trainee Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 7 Posts
basic_details.short_information: Seven Social Worker Trainee posts are open in the Emergency Department of Government Medical College Hospital, Thiruvananthapuram (Sarkar Medical College Asupathri, Thiruvananthapuram), under the Medical Education Department, Kerala. Candidates with a postgraduate degree in Social Work obtained within the last 3 years can apply online through the Medical College website, tmc.kerala.gov.in, until 5:00 PM on 21 November 2026. The first three months are non-stipendiary. If performance is satisfactory, the training is extended by six months as a stipendiary trainee.

qualification.details: Applicants must have a postgraduate degree in Social Work. Applicants must have obtained this qualification within the last 3 years.

The hospital then evaluates their work during these three months. | If the performance is satisfactory, the training period is extended by six more months as a stipendiary trainee. The notice does not mention the amount of the stipend.

how_to_apply: Applications must be made online, through the Medical College website (https://tmc.kerala.gov.in/).
The notice gives this online application link: https://forms.gle/ypuuh4ydyu2F6rLT7.
Submit the online application before 5:00 PM on 21 November 2026.
Check the website and your email after you apply. The hospital sends all information about this appointment by website or email.

content_sections.heading: About the Recruiting Hospital
content_sections.text: Government Medical College Hospital is the government teaching hospital at Medical College P.O., Thiruvananthapuram-695 011. It falls under the Medical Education Department (Arogya Vidyabhyasa Vakuppu) of Kerala. The Superintendent of the hospital issued this notice to strengthen the services of the hospital's Emergency Department (casualty). The subject line of the notice refers to the Karunya Arogya Suraksha Padhathi.

content_sections.heading: Seats by Trade
content_sections.text: The notice invites applications for a total of 7 Social Worker Trainees. All seats are in the Emergency Department. The notice does not give a category-wise break-up of the seats.

rows.unit: Emergency Department (casualty), Government Medical College Hospital, Thiruvananthapuram

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Applicants must have a postgraduate degree in Social Work. Applicants must have obtained this qualification within the last 3 years. The age limit is not specified in the notice. For the full eligibility conditions of the Social Worker Trainee post, see the official notification.

content_sections.heading: Stipend and Training Period
content_sections.text: Selected Social Worker Trainees are first appointed as non-stipendiary trainees for three months . The hospital then evaluates their work during these three months. If the performance is satisfactory, the training period is extended by six more months as a stipendiary trainee . The notice does not mention the amount of the stipend.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for GMCHT Social Worker Trainee
content_sections.text: Applications must be made online, through the Medical College website ( https://tmc.kerala.gov.in/ ). The notice gives this online application link: https://forms.gle/ypuuh4ydyu2F6rLT7 . Submit the online application before 5:00 PM on 21 November 2026. Check the website and your email after you apply. The hospital sends all information about this appointment by website or email. The notice does not list any documents to upload or enclose.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: The notice refers to an interview and document verification for this appointment. All information about these, including the dates, will be communicated through the website or email. The notice does not give their dates or venue.

content_sections.text: Only candidates who qualified in Social Work at postgraduate level within the last 3 years are eligible. faq.question: Q1. How many Social Worker Trainee posts are in GMCHT Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 7 Social Worker Trainee posts. All of them are in the Emergency Department of Government Medical College Hospital, Thiruvananthapuram.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the GMCHT Social Worker Trainee posts?
faq.answer: The last date is 21 November 2026. Online applications must be submitted before 5:00 PM on that day.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for Social Worker Trainee at Medical College Hospital Thiruvananthapuram?
faq.answer: You need a postgraduate degree in Social Work. You must have obtained it within the last 3 years.

faq.question: Q4. Is the GMCHT Social Worker Trainee post paid?
faq.answer: The first three months are non-stipendiary. If your performance is satisfactory, you continue for six more months as a stipendiary trainee. The notice does not state the stipend amount.

faq.question: Q5. How long is the GMCHT Social Worker Trainee training?
faq.answer: The training starts with three months as a non-stipendiary trainee. It is extended by six months as a stipendiary trainee if your work in the first three months is satisfactory.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for GMCHT Social Worker Trainee 2026?
faq.answer: Apply online through the Medical College website (https://tmc.kerala.gov.in/), using the online application link https://forms.gle/ypuuh4ydyu2F6rLT7. Submit the application before 5:00 PM on 21 November 2026.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the GMCHT Social Worker Trainee posts?
faq.answer: The notice refers to an interview and document verification. Details will be sent through the website or email.

faq.question: Q8. Where will the Social Worker Trainees be posted?
faq.answer: All 7 trainees will work in the Emergency Department of Government Medical College Hospital, Thiruvananthapuram.
